name: pay-late
title: Supplier invoices are paid late
note: Finance settles vendor bills about three weeks after the due date, so suppliers keep chasing us for money.

name: onboard-slow
title: Onboarding takes too long for new hires
note: A new employee waits up to ten days for a laptop, accounts and building access before real work starts.

name: churn-price
title: Customer churn rose after the price change
note: Cancellations went up in the two months after the subscription price increase.

name: ci-disk
title: Release builds break on the shared CI runners
note: Nightly pipelines fail because the build agents run out of disk space.

name: stock-errors
title: Warehouse picking errors
note: Pickers send the wrong item in about one order in fifty.

name: picnic
title: Choosing a venue for the summer team picnic
note: Two parks near the office are free on the last Friday of July; one has a covered area if it rains.

name: receivables
title: Customers pay our invoices late
note: Clients settle what they owe us about a month after we bill them, which squeezes cash.

name: desk-moves
title: Office floor plan for the third floor
note: Design and research move to the east side so the meeting rooms stay together.

name: api-latency
title: Search API latency regressed
note: The ninety-ninth percentile went from 200 ms to 900 ms after the index upgrade.

name: brand-colours
title: Refresh the brand colour palette
note: Marketing wants warmer greens and a darker navy for the website and slides.

name: tax-filing
title: Quarterly sales tax filing
note: The return for the last quarter is due on the twentieth and needs the regional breakdown.

name: mentoring
title: Start a mentoring scheme for junior engineers
note: Pair each graduate with a senior engineer for weekly one-to-one sessions.

name: backup-restore
title: Test restoring the database backups
note: Nobody has restored a nightly backup since the migration, so we do not know they work.

name: fleet-fuel
title: Delivery van fuel costs
note: Diesel spend for the delivery fleet is up a fifth on last year.

name: survey-results
title: Employee engagement survey results
note: Scores fell for workload and recognition; communication improved.

name: pair1
title: Vendors wait weeks to get paid
note: Accounts payable clears what we owe our providers long after the agreed date, and they ring to ask where the payment is.

name: pair2
title: New starters sit idle in their first fortnight
note: Recruits go without equipment, logins or a door badge for most of their opening week and a half.

name: pair3
title: Plan the next pricing tiers
note: Product wants a cheaper starter plan and an annual discount next year.

name: pair4
title: Automated compile jobs die overnight
note: Continuous integration machines fill their storage and the scheduled builds stop partway.

name: pair5
title: Inventory counts drift from the system
note: The quarterly stocktake finds shelves holding a different number of units than the records say.

name: control
title: Rotate the database encryption keys every quarter
note: Security policy asks for new keys each quarter and the old ones retired after a week.
